steps: Open the local tenant administration XianGuanJia configuration page.
Inspect enabled, endpoint, masked AppKey, blank AppSecret replacement input, write switch, job switch, and synchronization settings.
Confirm the backend runtime remains functional without XGJ business environment variables.
Use the running local backend with database-backed tenant configuration.
Inspect synchronized table counts and application switch state.
Run 27 read-only schema, tenant, and relation queries.
Load Today, Schedule, Rental orders, Device ledger, Shipping, and Exceptions.
Repeat at 360, 390, 768, and 1440 CSS pixel widths.
Check document overflow and unnamed interactive controls.
Search an available device by SN.
Search pending orders independently by receiver name, full phone, and order number.
Verify authorized results include full verification fields.
Clear all searches and inspect URL, DOM, final screenshots, write-disabled reason, and no-optimistic-update copy.
Switch to light theme and zh-CN locale.
Reload and verify both preferences persist.
Restore dark theme and English.
Open the account menu, dismiss with Escape, and verify trigger focus restoration.
Inspect the latest browser console.
Open the authenticated local rental-orders page after the management snapshot loads.
Verify the first and second pages render 10 cards and expose previous/next state correctly.
Verify complete receiver name, phone, and address labels are present without masked card text.
Search independently by receiver name, phone, and address and verify each match resets to page one.
Repeat the bounded list and overflow checks at desktop and 390 CSS pixel widths without retaining customer values.
